description: This source file contains utility functions and data structures related to handling wizard options, wizard steps, and type conversions using the AnyCodable type in a Swift project. It supports encoding, decoding, and type inference for wizard-related data.

classes.name: WizardOption
classes.description: A data structure representing an option in a wizard, including its value, label, and additional hint information.

methods.name: decodeWizardStep
methods.description: Decodes a raw dictionary into a WizardStep object using JSON encoding/decoding.

methods.name: parseWizardOptions
methods.description: Creates an array of WizardOption objects from raw data.

methods.name: wizardStatusString
methods.description: Returns a trimmed, lowercase string status from an AnyCodable value.

methods.name: wizardStepType
methods.description: Retrieves the 'type' string from a WizardStep.

methods.name: anyCodableString
methods.description: Converts an AnyCodable value to its string representation.

methods.name: anyCodableBool
methods.description: Interprets an AnyCodable value as a boolean.

methods.name: anyCodableArray
methods.description: Converts an AnyCodable value to an array of AnyCodable.

methods.name: anyCodableEqual
methods.description: Compares two AnyCodable values for equality.
